# Aliqyaan Mahimwala — Portfolio

> Full Stack Developer & Computer Engineering Student

## About

Aliqyaan Mahimwala is a 20-year-old Computer Engineering student at Fr. Conceicao Rodrigues College of Engineering (Fr. CRCE) in Bandra, Mumbai. He is a full stack web developer who specializes in building clean, smooth, and user-friendly web applications.

## Areas of Expertise

- **Full-Stack Development**: Creating seamless user experiences with modern frameworks including React, Next.js, and Django.
- **Interactive 3D & VR**: Building immersive digital experiences with Three.js and WebVR technologies.
- **AI Integration**: Incorporating intelligent features to enhance application capabilities.

## Technical Skills

- **Frontend**: React, Next.js, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Three.js
- **Backend**: Django, Node.js, Express, Python
- **Databases**: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Supabase
- **Tools & DevOps**: Git, GitHub, Vercel, Docker
- **AI/ML**: Integration of AI models and APIs
